control_binding.bootstrap_recovery_note: An initial non-SHA control read and pre-bootstrap exploration were quarantined and excluded from semantic conclusions; SHA-only exact-SHA bootstrap was then completed and the substantive public-source probes used in this checkpoint were performed again under the frozen tuple.

public_observations.text: ScientistOne binds factual claims in its internal research representation to workspace evidence tags. Numerical Claim Provenance Rate checking binds sentences containing numbers to experimental_log.md line references; 627/639 claims passed automatically (98.1%), with the paper estimating roughly 99% after manual review of flagged cases.

ScientistOne deliberately strips inline evidence annotations from final LaTeX. Internal native claim provenance and downstream export replayability are therefore distinct properties unless a sidecar or equivalent claim-to-artifact map is preserved.

ScientistOne Method-Code Alignment is LLM-judged with majority vote and Score Verification re-executes solutions. Its complete audit is therefore useful mechanism evidence but not a zero-external-executor, zero-model-dependency Phase-1 acceptance mechanism.

The inspected current ScientistOne official artifact repository is heterogeneous by task family: ADRS exposes per-seed solution scripts and PDFs, while MLE ai4code additionally exposes best_run_meta.json, evaluation_metrics.json, ablation, and search_artifacts. Repository code search did not surface experimental_log.md; this is an absence only on the inspected current public surface.

SkeMex makes skill memory context-conditioned: it extracts a clinical category, constrains task-level retrieval by branch/context, and conditions general-skill utility on clinical category; admitted skill drafts require a situational trigger and concrete steps.

SkeMex Table 11 reports average 53.22 for the full retrieval pipeline versus 47.64 Similarity Only (-5.58), 48.30 Utility Only (-4.92), 50.93 LLM Ranking Only, and 50.69 without Prescreen. This supports context-aware/value-aware memory selection over topical similarity alone.

SkeMex memory admission/governance ablations also reduce average performance: 53.22 full versus 48.82 without Draft Review, 47.56 without Buffer Gating, and 49.27 without Deprecation. These are lifecycle/repository interventions, not an isolated receiver-side revalidation test.

SkeMex does not hold the same stored and retrieved failure record fixed while changing only a receiver-side applicability accept/reject predicate. The exact science-domain matched-revalidation frontier therefore remains unresolved.

protocol_inferences.name: CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MAP_PERSISTENCE
protocol_inferences.text: If verification depends on claim-to-artifact bindings, preserve a machine-readable exported sidecar keyed by stable claim/span identity and artifact digest rather than stripping the only replay path.

protocol_inferences.name: REPLAY_MODE_DECLARATION
protocol_inferences.text: Evidence packages should declare whether each verification predicate is replayable by static inspection, semantic/LLM review, or code re-execution; dependency-bearing replay modes cannot silently count as Phase-1 scheduled-Chat-native acceptance.

protocol_inferences.name: EXPORT_COVERAGE_PARITY
protocol_inferences.text: The exported/public package must preserve sufficient claim-evidence coverage to reproduce material verifier conclusions; internal coverage cannot be inferred for an export that strips provenance bindings.

protocol_inferences.name: ARTIFACT_FAMILY_COMPLETENESS
protocol_inferences.text: Replayability must be evaluated per task/artifact family; a rich archive in one family does not establish replayability for a thinner family.

protocol_inferences.name: CONTEXT_CONDITIONED_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL_IS_NOT_POST_RETRIEVAL_AUTHORIZATION
protocol_inferences.text: Context-aware retrieval can reduce mismatched memory use but is not causal evidence for a receiver-side post-retrieval applicability/authorization gate when the retrieved record itself is not held fixed.

protocol_inferences.name: FAILURE_MEMORY_TRIGGER_FIELD
protocol_inferences.text: Failure-derived operational memory should retain an explicit situational trigger/applicability statement alongside provenance; similarity/relevance scoring should not erase the conditions under which the record was learned.

protocol_artifacts.reason: ScientistOne establishes export/replay packaging invariants and SkeMex strengthens context-applicability evidence, but neither primary artifact establishes a new lifecycle mutation that justifies changing the existing canonical validators in this invocation.

residual_dependency_findings: ScientistOne's full audit relies on LLM semantic judgments and solution re-execution; some audit interpretation also uses manual review, so it is not accepted as a zero-dependency Phase-1 completion mechanism.
SkeMex relies on model/tool execution and is used only as architecture evidence, not as a Phase-1 accepted replay mechanism.
phase1_assessment.candidate_component: A static claim-evidence sidecar with immutable artifact digests and explicitly static verification predicates remains a promising Chat-native packaging component, but end-to-end parity and coverage are not yet established.
